standard.summary: YOLO 从预训练权重起手还是从结构随机初始化。默认开启。
standard.effect: 开启时把 pretrained=True 交给 ultralytics；从已有 checkpoint 续训时该值被忽略，因为续训本身已经带着权重。
standard.whenToUse: 绝大多数场景保持开启——从零开始训检测器需要多得多的数据与步数。
standard.avoidWhen: 做结构消融、或刻意要一组随机初始化的对照时关掉。

standard_en.summary: Whether YOLO starts from pretrained weights or a randomly initialised architecture. On by default.
standard_en.effect: When on, pretrained=True is handed to ultralytics; resuming from an existing checkpoint ignores the value, since the checkpoint already carries the weights.
standard_en.whenToUse: Keep it on almost always -- training a detector from scratch needs far more data and steps.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Turn it off for architecture ablations or when you deliberately want a random-init control arm.

advanced.principle: entry_yolo 只在 pretrained 有值且没有 resume 路径时写 train_kwargs['pretrained']，然后按 resume 与否决定用 YOLO(resume) 还是 YOLO(model)。
advanced.intervention: worker 组装 ultralytics kwargs 时的一次条件写入。
advanced.expectedImpact: 开启后前若干 epoch 的收敛明显更快；关闭时速度不变但需要更长时间。
advanced.tradeoffs: 与 pretrained_model_name_or_path（权重路径）是两件事：这个开关决定「用不用」，那个决定「用哪个」。

advanced_en.principle: entry_yolo writes train_kwargs['pretrained'] only when the value is present and there is no resume path, then picks YOLO(resume) or YOLO(model) depending on resume.
advanced_en.intervention: One conditional write while assembling the ultralytics kwargs.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Convergence over the first epochs is clearly faster with it on; off does not change speed, just how long the run needs.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: It is distinct from pretrained_model_name_or_path: this switch decides whether weights are used, that one decides which.
